display.purpose: Base display role; the solid/outlined home wordmark overrides it at 80px, 64px at 1000px and 56px at 800px with weight 900, 1.05 leading and -0.035em tracking.

display-mobile.purpose: Base mobile display role; the factual home wordmark overrides it at 36px below 600px and 32px below 360px.

headline-mobile.purpose: General page heading at 600px and below.

shadows.name: control-seam
shadows.purpose: Outline-button seam; shared fields and floating controls remove this shadow.

motion.name: route-underline
motion.purpose: Motion shared layout projection moves the active route underline between links.

motion.name: root-crossfade
motion.purpose: Native whole-root crossfade preserves scene-sampling glass without a permanent named main backdrop root; the unchanged header stays visually anchored. A slow snapshot releases after 700ms while real loading feedback continues.

motion.name: home-wordmark-draw-reveal
motion.purpose: One ring-arc draw and temporary filled-letter reveal, then the solid/outlined wordmark rests. The outlined and filled letterforms share an inline grid cell; reduced motion presents the final form immediately. The supplied character remains static.

motion.name: navigation-pending
motion.purpose: A 3px top bar paints its 12% segment on the first pending frame for real route work, initial SWR loads and explicit preview/search requests. It advances below 90% while pending, completes after a 220ms minimum visible interval and retains a 180ms visual tail; accessible pending ends with actual work. Reduced motion holds the pending segment still and shows completion without transitions.

materials.excludedGroups: Use the matching solid-surface levels and zero material blur.
materials.floatingControls: Always use glass-surface levels and panel blur, including portals at minimum coverage.
materials.nestedFields: Disable a second backdrop filter inside an already filtered container.

siteHeader.purpose: Includes the utility row, route row and actual one-pixel seams.

profileNavigation.purpose: Sticky section navigation clears the shared shell; anchors also clear the section rail.

compactHeader.purpose: Keeps the brand mark and utility controls; profile access remains in mobile navigation.

difficultyPopover.purpose: Contains preview links within the actual available floating region.

homeMapRecord.purpose: Compact home selectors preserve geometry and a thin hover/focus veil over later shared record rules.

narrative.overview:
Illyaverse presents players, beatmaps and scores as connected community records. A pure-black default canvas supports thin neutral glass, joined identity and fact bands, aligned numeric values and rounded bilingual lettering. Strong headings, quieter metadata and accent underlines make location and selection clear without decorative copy.

Personalization is part of the material. The visitor can adjust theme, accent, background blur and dim, glass coverage, panel blur and opacity, and radius independently. Coverage selects which surface groups use glass; the remaining groups use deliberate solid counterparts. The viewed player’s public accent remains distinct from the visitor’s private appearance. Light mode uses neutral white and gray replacements, while zh-TW, en and ja share the same hierarchy and wrapping behavior.

The source composition studies of osu-web and Sunset inform recognizable community structure; Illyaverse’s source, palette and geometry are original. Runtime official beatmap covers and player-uploaded avatars, banners and backgrounds provide identity. The user-authorized transparent homepage character is a separate, original-byte asset above the plain black default background. Its provenance is recorded beside the image; it does not establish a decorative page background. A profile without a banner reserves no empty artwork region. Provenance is recorded in [the website redesign record](docs/website-redesign.md) and [the dense interface source record](docs/dense-interface-verification.md).
keyCharacteristics: Pure-black default canvas with adjustable thin neutral glass and solid counterparts.
Joined heading, toolbar, identity and record surfaces.
Rounded Nunito Variable and Noto Sans TC typography.
Personal accent underlines, readable highlights and aligned performance facts.
Real covers and player uploads with useful missing-image fallbacks.
Paired light/dark semantic colors, meaningful labels and bounded overflow.
Shared shadcn/Radix fields and floating menus with consistent material and keyboard states.
Compact catalogue rows with difficulty detail available on demand.
Purposeful route orientation and request feedback with reduced-motion alternatives.

rules.name: The Personal Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the runtime accent and readable-accent roles for actions and emphasis; preserve the distinction between visitor appearance and a player’s public accent.

rules.name: The Separate Meanings Rule
rules.body: Location and selection use the personal accent. Status, grade and numeric difficulty use their own semantic roles and always retain readable labels.

rules.name: The Bilingual Breathing Rule
rules.body: Preserve line-height, meaningful mode labels and wrapping when translating; let the layout adapt before compressing text.

rules.name: The Local Overflow Rule
rules.body: Keep dense tables, technical strings and long navigation inside their own scrollable regions; the document must remain within the viewport.

rules.name: The Independent Material Rule
rules.body: Background blur and dim control the scene; coverage selects glass surface groups; panel blur and opacity control their material. Keep all five controls and effects independent.

rules.name: The Solid Counterpart Rule
rules.body: Every group excluded by coverage uses the corresponding opaque surface levels and zero material blur; never expose content directly over an arbitrary uploaded background.

rules.name: The Joined Record Rule
rules.body: Connect related heading, controls and content within one outer silhouette; use seams and surface levels to show internal structure.

dos: Do use semantic foreground/surface pairs and runtime accent variables in both themes.
Do assign each surface its navigation/floating, identity, section or content material group and preserve its solid counterpart.
Do use shared shadcn/Radix Select and DropdownMenu controls with visible checked, highlighted, focus and disabled states.
Do connect entity identity, facts, controls and records with clear surface levels and seams.
Do align comparable numeric values and use tabular figures for ranks, scores and control outputs.
Do retain labels alongside status, grade and difficulty color, and show only facts provided by the running API.
Do preserve 44px difficulty-summary and score action targets, complete read-only card previews and every available difficulty link in the full set selector.
Do keep keyboard focus visible, honor reduced motion and contain dense horizontal content locally.
Do use ordinary zh-TW/en/ja labels, real runtime covers, player-uploaded media and the explicitly authorized original homepage character.
Do keep route motion purposeful and request feedback tied to outstanding work, including a reduced-motion presentation.
donts: Don't copy upstream source, design assets, palettes or exact geometry.
Don't add AI-generated art, decorative default backgrounds or poetic marketing slogans; the authorized homepage character does not change that background rule.
Don't merge coverage, background or panel controls, or replace user appearance with fixed visual values.
Don't extend the explicitly requested profile rank gradient text to other typography or describe absolute rank bands as percentiles.
Don't add an empty profile banner or decorative height when a player has no banner.
Don't infer a passed score’s letter grade from accuracy when the API lacks the required information.
Don't promote obsolete, unused styles or one-off small metadata values into the shared type system.
